# Vietnam Thermal Power Plant Reference Inventory (>30 MWe)

> **Methodology note:** This inventory is compiled from parametric knowledge of Vietnamese government documents (Power Development Plans, EVN/NLDC reports, MOIT decisions), multilateral development bank project documents, and industry sources available up to my knowledge cutoff (early 2025). Because I cannot browse the internet, **URLs are cited as known canonical addresses**; readers should verify current availability. Where a source URL is uncertain, the document title and issuing body are given so the reader can locate it independently. Figures reflect PDP7 Revised (Decision 428/QĐ-TTg, 2016), **PDP8 (Decision 500/QĐ-TTg, 18 May 2023)**, and associated MOIT/EVN implementation documents. Capacity figures follow nameplate MWe unless otherwise noted.

---

## Abbreviations

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| EVN | Electricity of Vietnam |
| PVN / PV Power | Petrovietnam / Petrovietnam Power Corporation |
| Vinacomin / TKV | Vietnam National Coal-Mineral Industries Group |
| BOT | Build-Operate-Transfer |
| IPP | Independent Power Producer |
| SC | Supercritical |
| USC | Ultra-supercritical |
| SubC | Subcritical |
| CCGT | Combined-Cycle Gas Turbine |
| OCGT | Open-Cycle Gas Turbine |
| COD | Commercial Operation Date |
| PDP8 | Power Development Plan VIII (2021-2030) |
| MOIT | Ministry of Industry and Trade |
| NĐ | Nhiệt điện (Thermal Power) |

---

> **Column guide — Sources:** "Source 1" is the primary Vietnamese government/regulatory document; "Source 2" is a secondary corroborating source (MDB, developer, or industry report). Both are cited with document title + issuing body + known URL or locator.

## Critical Caveats and Data Quality Notes

> 1. **URL stability:** Vietnamese government portal URLs (chinhphu.vn, moit.gov.vn) are subject to restructuring. If a URL returns a 404, search the document number (e.g., "500/QĐ-TTg") on the portal's search function.
> 2. **Capacity figures:** Nameplate MWe figures for older SubC plants (pre-2005) may differ from net sent-out capacity by 3–8%. Figures here are nameplate unless noted.
> 3. **COD dates:** For plants under construction or planned, COD dates are PDP8 targets and are frequently revised. Long Phu 1 and Vung Ang 2 are particularly uncertain.
> 4. **LNG pipeline:** PDP8 targets ~22,400 MWe of LNG-fired capacity by 2030. As of early 2025, only Nhon Trach 3 & 4 are under active construction. Most LNG projects face financing, terminal, and PPA challenges.
> 5. **Coal phase-out:** PDP8 commits to no new coal approvals after 2030 and targets retirement of pre-2000 plants. Pha Lai 1, Ninh Binh, and Uong Bi original units are candidates for near-term retirement.
> 6. **Ownership changes:** Several BOT plants have transferred or are transferring to EVN/PV Power upon BOT expiry. Ownership column reflects developer/operator as of 2023–2024.
> 7. **Plants below 30 MWe threshold:** Several small diesel and biomass co-generation plants exist but are excluded per scope.
> 8. **This table should not be used as a sole source for investment or regulatory decisions.** Cross-reference with current MOIT/EVN official publications.
